# [legacy-001] HazardWithProseProperties

## Condition

The vehicle does not reduce speed when the operator commands deceleration.

## Assessment

| Severity | Likelihood | Rationale |
| -------- | ---------- | --------- |
| critical | remote | Injures occupants. |

## Properties

The hazard is identified by a UUID, carries the condition text, and records
when it was first observed. This is the pre-0.3.0 prose form: a reader can
follow it, nothing can type it.
